title: CoRE: Weakly Supervised Coarse-to-Fine Risk Evidence Learning in Driving Videos
abstract: arXiv:2608.25344v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Driver perceived risk evolves in dynamic environments and is supported by specific scene entities, yet supervision is typically limited to coarse video-level judgments. Learning when supporting evidence emerges and which entities support a risk predictor would require costly temporal- and entity-level annotations. We introduce CoRE, a weakly supervised coarse-to-fine framework that learns fine-grained prediction support from coarse video supervision. CoRE trains and freezes a video-level predictor. Structured interventions over candidate temporal regions or entity tracks measure how each candidate changes the coarse prediction, producing graded prediction-effect targets. These targets are distilled into a student that directly predicts temporal and entity support from the original video, without interventions at inference. translated_title: CoRE：驾驶视频中弱监督的由粗到细风险证据学习
translated_abstract: 驾驶者的感知风险在动态环境中不断演变，并由特定的场景实体所支撑，然而监督信号通常仅限于粗粒度的视频级判断。若要学习支持证据何时出现、以及哪些实体支撑风险预测器，将需要昂贵的时间级和实体级标注。我们提出了CoRE，这是一个弱监督的由粗到细框架，能够从粗粒度的视频级监督中学习细粒度的预测支持信息。CoRE先训练并冻结一个视频级预测器，随后通过对候选时间段区域或实体轨迹进行结构化干预，测量每个候选如何改变粗粒度预测，从而生成分级的预测效果目标。这些目标被蒸馏到一个学生模型中，该学生模型能够直接从原始视频预测时间与实体层面的支持信息，而无需在推理时进行干预。我们在三个互补的设置中评估了这一学习原则。RISEE用于测试感知风险支持……
tldr: CoRE提出了一种弱监督的由粗到细框架，仅利用视频级粗粒度标签，通过结构化干预产生分级预测效果目标并蒸馏给学生模型，从而学习驾驶视频中细粒度的时间与实体级风险证据，避免了昂贵的时间级和实体级标注。
en_tdlr: CoRE is a weakly supervised coarse-to-fine framework that learns fine-grained temporal and entity-level risk evidence in driving videos from only coarse video-level labels, by using structured interventions to generate graded prediction-effect targets that are distilled into a student model, thereby avoiding costly temporal and entity-level annotations.
